feeds.title: Dissent Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Dissent Magazine is the oldest democratic socialist magazine in the United States, an independent quarterly magazine, publishing some of America's most exciting long-form political and cultural criticism since 1954.

feeds.title: Insider NJ
feeds.description: Dedicated to political news in the state of New Jersey. InsiderNJ is a nonpartisan website which brings you bold and insightful must-read real-time news for New Jersey's political and government insiders.

feeds.title: New Jersey Democratic State Committee
feeds.description: The New Jersey Democratic State Committee (NJDSC) promotes Democratic values by supporting the good work of Democrats at every level of New Jersey politics and government. Stay connected to the ground situation with timely updates, analyses and fresh perspectives from the experts.

feeds.title: NJ Spotlight News
feeds.description: Back in March 2019, NJTV News and NJ Spotlight—both trusted, member-supported, award-winning independent news sources in New Jersey—were brought together under WNET to create a new, multi-platform approach to local, in-depth journalism in the state. NJ Spotlight News is here and will continue to be here serving the community and lighting a path to a better-informed New Jersey.

feeds.title: New Jersey Monitor
feeds.description: The New Jersey Monitor is an independent, nonprofit and nonpartisan news site that strives to be a watchdog for all residents of the Garden State. Created and run by passionate staff, the Monitor aims to empower readers with the information they need to understand the world around them and make informed choices.

feeds.title: New Jersey Assembly Democrats
feeds.description: The New Jersey Assembly Democrats website is your gateway to progressive policies, community empowerment, and legislative leadership in the Garden State. This news page serves as a hub for information on our members, their initiatives, and the vital issues we champion. Saty informed.

feeds.title: Green Party of New Jersey
feeds.description: The Green Party of New Jersey runs candidates for political office aligned with the party's 4 pillars, peace, ecology, democracy, and social justice. Get updates on the party's ongoing fights and how you can make a difference.
